notes:
- New jacket and insulation materials: LSZH, CSPE (Hypalon), PEEK and TPC-ET (Hytrel).
- New foams with their own density, so buoyancy uses the foam rather than the solid polymer: foamed FEP and a buoyant closed-cell PUR jacket.
- New strength members and fillers: UHMWPE (Dyneema), Vectran, cotton, water-blocking yarn and talc release powder. The yarns also come as air-loaded filler presets.
- New tapes: water-blocking (swellable) tape and paper tape.
- New conductor metals for drawings and DC resistance: copper-clad aluminum, stainless steel and galvanized steel.
- The example project (Help > Open Example Project) has an updated EX-1001 layout with fresh simulation results.
